messages:
maria.partnerships: Kicking off the marketplace onboarding handoff for the new tenant rollout. Primary asks: AMI/region mapping, KMS key ownership, trial entitlement mapping, and a short runbook for networking (VPC, peering, firewall rules). Can folks confirm owners?

jake.eng: I can own AMI + region mapping. Need the list of target regions and expected minimum instance types (we've got amp/g5s on Dedicated).

sarah.legal: I will review the publisher agreement for marketplace terms. Quick heads-up: we need a 3-day lead time for any eula localization requests.

tom.ops: I'll take KMS and networking. Which KMS approach do we want: customer-managed key (CMK) in their account, or a Redwood-managed envelope key for private deployments?

maria.partnerships: For Private customers we prefer CMK in customer account. For hosted/Dedicated we'll recommend customer KMS if they require separation, otherwise Redwood-managed with audit logs. Please add any exceptions.

jake.eng: Region list attached (short): us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, europe-west2. For AMIs we'll produce one per region. Quick question: do we want HVM vs Nitro optimization? Nitro preferred for perf.

sarah.legal: Confirming: we must include marketplace trial duration in the contract + clear cancellation flow. Nate-sourcing needs to confirm trial SKU mapping to billing plan.

nate.sales: I'll map trial SKUs to the billing plan. Can you send the canonical SKU names? also we need the trial entitlement attributes (concurrent sessions, token cap).

jake.eng: provisional SKU names: redwood-pro-trial, redwood-pro-paid. Token caps: trial=100k tokens/mo, paid=unlimited (metered). Adding to docs.

tom.ops: Networking runbook draft snippet:```
# Networking checklist
- Create VPC with /20
- Create peering to customer VPC (if private)
- Open ports 443 and 8443 to partner IPs
- Ensure route table has NAT for outbound
- Confirm security group allows outbound to S3 endpoints for artifacts
```
Please review and sign off.

maria.partnerships: This is great. Action items: Jake -> AMIs + region builds (ETA 3 days). Tom -> KMS runbook + networking playbook (ETA 2 days). Sarah -> contract clause update (ETA 4 days). Nate -> trial SKU mapping (ETA 1 day). I'll schedule a 30-min sync Friday to finalize.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: AMI build job queued (#ami-build-172333). Status will post here.

jake.eng: noted. I'll post AMI IDs in the thread once builds finish, and include a small terraform example for marketplace listing tests.

maria.partnerships: Thanks team — if anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. I'll send calendar invite for the Friday sync. :rocket:
